notes.title: 1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
v1.0.2
- Leaderboards display the top 100 for all periods (Daily, Weekly, Monthly and All Time)
- Now players can see their position and score on all rank periods, even if they are not in top 100.
- fixed Cloud flickering when playing using Mouse

notes.title: 1.0.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing our game! Here is the list of the improvements we did by hearing your feedback:

- Game Over now triggers at the correct time.
- Now players can adjust sound settings from the main menu. 

We have more to come! Thank you!

notes.title: We Appreciate Your Feedback!
notes.notes:
We want to express our gratitude for all the feedback we've been receiving. We're meticulously recording each one, and we're committed to improving the game and addressing any issues that arise. We sincerely thank everyone who's sharing their ideas with us. Additionally, stay tuned, as we'll also have some exciting news coming soon.

We appreciate your patience and ongoing support.

Best regards,
Team Frozen Logic.

notes.title: Now available for download!
notes.notes: Finally, the launch day has arrived. We sincerely apologize for the delay. We are two game enthusiasts, an artist and a programmer. Balancing our jobs and our families with the creation of this game, and dedicating our free time to it has been a true pleasure, far from just another task. We acknowledge that the game still needs some adjustments, but we have many exciting ideas to incorporate into this, our first project. Ultimately, we hope you enjoy and have as much fun playing it as we did creating it.

notes.title: +4000 Wishlist Additions!!!!!!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that with less than a month in pre-release, we have surpassed over 4,000 additions to the Steam wishlist. 
We want to thank everyone who, like us, is eager for the game's launch. We are working hard to make this a reality.

notes.title: Steam approval and delays
notes.notes: Apologies to everyone. We're actively working on getting Steam to approve the game's initial version. Due to the holiday season, Steam's support has been delayed in responding to us. We're planning to submit a new version for approval this week, but please note that Steam might take up to 5 days to provide a response. According to Steam support, we're unable to change the date unless we have an approved version. We're striving to ensure the game is released within this month. We appreciate everyone's patience and support.

notes.title: Game Release Delay Due to Steam Promotion
notes.notes:
Due to the big end-of-year promotion on Steam, we received valuable advice from the platform's support team: postpone the release date of our game to avoid possible negative impacts. Therefore, we decided to extend the launch until [u]January 5, 2024[/u]. We understand the anxiety about seeing the game live, but this choice was made to ensure that the launch is a success.

We're excited about the prospect and interest the game has generated, with over 1000 wishlists reached tonight. We are very grateful to all our future players for all their support and patience. We are working hard to offer the best experience possible and we are sure it will be worth the wait.

Thank you for your continued support and we can't wait to share this exciting game with you all.

Kind regards FrozenLogic Team
